description: This file defines the interface DosingInstructions, which specifies methods for representing, serializing, and validating drug dosing instructions within the OpenMRS project. It includes method signatures for retrieving localized instructions, associating instructions with DrugOrder objects, and estimating auto-expiration dates.

classes.name: DosingInstructions
classes.description: An interface representing different ways to encode drug dosing instructions, including localization, serialization, validation, and expiration date inference.

methods.name: getDosingInstructionsAsString
methods.description: Returns a localized human-readable string of dosing instructions for a given locale.

methods.name: setDosingInstructions
methods.description: Serializes the dosing instructions into a DrugOrder object.

methods.name: getDosingInstructions
methods.description: Extracts dosing instructions from a given DrugOrder object, potentially throwing an APIException if types do not match.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the dosing instructions against a DrugOrder, recording any errors.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Infers the auto-expiration date from a DrugOrder, or returns null if unknown.
